result.final_text:
## What this letter says
This letter is about your rheumatology review on 17 September 2026.
The letter says to continue your current medicines.
It also says to keep having your blood tests at your GP surgery.
You will have another rheumatology review in 6 months.

## What you need to do
1. Continue your current medicines.
2. Continue to have blood tests every 3 months at your GP surgery.

## Dates and medicines
Dates:
- Your review was on 17 September 2026.
- Your next rheumatology review is in 6 months. The letter does not give the exact date.
- Blood tests at your GP surgery are every 3 months.

Medicines:
- Methotrexate: 15 mg, once a WEEK, on Mondays. Continue.
- Folic acid: 5 mg, once a week, on Thursdays. Continue.
- Ibuprofen: 400 mg, up to 3 times a day with food, when needed for joint pain. Continue.

## Questions to ask your doctor
- What is methotrexate, and what is it for?
- When will I get the exact date of my next review?
- Who will tell me the results of my blood tests?

## When to get urgent help
The letter does not list specific warning signs.

If you are worried and it is not an emergency, call NHS 111. In an emergency, call 999.

---
